name: app-factory
description: Portable AI software-development factory with automatic software-intent routing, planning, tool selection, architecture, UI, security and executable verification.

interface.shortDescription: Automatically route, plan, build and verify software work.
interface.longDescription: A portable software-development factory that activates from software intent without requiring the user to name the Factory, then plans complete functional slices, routes work to the right agent, chooses coherent technology/UI and requires executable verification before completion.
defaultPrompt: I want to create a software system. Route it through App Factory automatically.
Route this software task to ChatGPT or Codex and plan a complete, verifiable slice.
Review the UI approach and verification plan.
